text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** A cafeteria-style plate with a creamy Caesar-type romaine salad, a side of steamed broccoli, and a small stir-fry of red/wild rice with tofu, tomato, peppers and glazed broccoli.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A large white square dinner plate, about 25.5 cm per side. Because it is square, I used side² instead of the circle formula: area ≈ 650 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Romaine salad with creamy dressing (plus some cheese and crouton bits)
- Steamed broccoli
- Red/wild rice
- Glazed broccoli in the stir-fry
- Tofu cubes
- Tomato and pepper pieces
- Sauce/oil in the stir-fry

**STEP 4 - Area:** Food covers about 50% of the plate.

| Item | Share of plate |
|---|---|
| Salad | 30% |
| Steamed broccoli | 6% |
| Rice | 6% |
| Stir-fry broccoli | 4% |
| Tofu | 2% |
| Tomato/peppers | 2% |
| **Total** | **50%** |

**STEPS 5–7 - Volume, grams, energy:**

| Item | Area | × Height | = Volume | × Density | = Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Salad | 195 cm² | 3 cm | 585 ml | 0.2 (dressed, wilted) | 117 g | 140 | 164 |
| Steamed broccoli | 39 cm² | 3 cm | 117 ml | 0.5 | 58 g | 35 | 20 |
| Red/wild rice | 39 cm² | 1.5 cm | 59 ml | 0.8 | 47 g | 125 | 59 |
| Stir-fry broccoli | 26 cm² | 3 cm | 78 ml | 0.55 | 43 g | 50 | 22 |
| Tofu | 13 cm² | 1.5 cm | 20 ml | 1.0 | 20 g | 150 | 30 |
| Tomato/peppers | 13 cm² | 1.5 cm | 20 ml | 0.6 | 12 g | 30 | 4 |
| Sauce/oil | — | — | — | — | ~6 g | 500 | 30 |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 303 g and 329 kcal. That is plausible for a half-covered plate that is dominated by an airy salad.
